A model page that states context window as its own property, separate from token limits.

## gemini-context-window-property

| Property | Description |
|---|---|
| Model code | `gemini-context-window-property` |
| Supported data types | **Inputs** Text **Output** Text |
| Context window | 1,048,576 tokens |
| Token limits | **Input token limit** 1,048,576 **Output token limit** 65,536 |
| Knowledge cutoff | January 2025 |
